description: Needs sign-in: Look up whether the Compute Engine can do something before you claim it. Pass a concept keyword (e.g. "prime factorization", "eigenvalues") or a LaTeX trigger (e.g. "\gcd", "\int"). Multiple keywords are OR-matched, so listing a few synonyms casts a wider net (e.g. "modulo floor divide remainder") rather than narrowing the search. The result lists matching registered operators, each with its canonical name and whether it is actually evaluable. Trust the result: if nothing evaluable matches, the capability is NOT available — say so rather than inventing a function.

query.description: One or more concept keywords (OR-matched) or a LaTeX trigger to search for.

name: lookup_math_capability
title: Look up a math capability
